subject.title: fix(browser): tab creation steals window focus during agent automation

question: Should the extension relay intentionally make an omitted `Target.createTarget.background` request open in the background, diverging from CDP's foreground default so Playwright/OpenClaw automation does not steal focus?
rationale: The implementation preserves every explicit CDP focus combination, but no automated check can decide whether the relay's omitted-parameter behavior is a public compatibility contract or an OpenClaw-owned automation policy.

options.title: Approve background-by-default relay policy
options.body: Accept the intentional omitted-parameter deviation because the relay primarily serves OpenClaw automation and explicit foreground requests remain available.

options.title: Preserve strict CDP omission semantics
options.body: Rework the OpenClaw-owned page-creation path to request background creation without changing generic relay clients that omit both parameters.

options.title: Pause the relay portion
options.body: Land no relay-default change until the intended external CDP compatibility boundary is documented and owned.

recommendation.title: Approve background-by-default relay policy
recommendation.body: Accept the intentional omitted-parameter deviation because the relay primarily serves OpenClaw automation and explicit foreground requests remain available.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent adjacent browser-focus merge provides the clearest evidence of responsibility for implicit-focus policy in this module.
